result.title: Speculative Self-Distillation enables Efficient Knowledge Internalization
result.comment: NeurIPS 2026. 26 pages, 8 figures, 12 tables. Project page: https://ssd-distill.github.io/ Code: https://github.com/ShayanTalaei/SpeculativeSelfDistillation
result.summary: Many real-world applications require language models to internalize knowledge that was absent from pretraining, to incorporate continually updated facts, or to learn new domain skills. Self-distillation has emerged as a natural approach for this task. A model conditioned on the source material acts as the teacher, and an unconditioned student is trained to reproduce the teacher's behavior closed-book. We propose Speculative Self-Distillation (SSD), an efficient per-token mixed-policy method for self-distillation. The student generates each rollout by default, while the teacher intervenes only at positions where its next-token distribution substantially diverges from the student's. Unlike off-policy distillation with teacher-generated prefixes, this design keeps training rollouts close to the student's test-time behavior, while avoiding the low-signal states that fully on-policy rollouts drift into. In effect, SSD lets the teacher steer the rollout exactly where the privileged context changes the prediction. On three closed-book QA benchmarks measuring fact recall, knowledge updates, and skill acquisition, SSD nearly matches on-policy distillation while using 38-69% fewer supervised tokens and consistently outperforms off-policy distillation on the held-out test set. On a forgetting stress test, SSD retains the most general capability while also achieving the best in-domain accuracy and using less supervision than the on-policy baseline. Overall, SSD establishes a new accuracy-efficiency-forgetting Pareto frontier for self-distillation.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Speculative Self-Distillation，一种按 token 混合策略的自蒸馏方法：默认由学生生成 rollout，仅当教师（带特权上下文）与学生下一 token 分布显著分歧时介入，从而以更少监督 token 接近 on-policy 蒸馏效果并减轻遗忘。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按分布分歧决定教师介入位置的思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 轨迹的监督贡献分配与稀疏监督提供线索，但论文为纯文本、无视觉状态，迁移可行性需核查。
